summary: How to prepare three files (DESIGN.md, design system, reusable template) to create polished, on-brand slide decks in Claude Design, with feedback that carries forward.
audience: Beginners to intermediate users of Claude Design, likely professionals or creators who want to improve their design workflow.
styleGuide: Use casual, friendly tone with です・ます体 for politeness but keep conversational.
Translate 'you' as あなた or omit, prefer みなさん for audience.
Keep English product names (Claude Design, ChatGPT, etc.) as is.
Use Japanese loanwords for technical terms (テンプレート, プロンプト, etc.) where natural.
For 'pun intended', consider adding a note like ダジャレです or rephrase naturally.
Use 〜ましょう for suggestions, 〜てください for instructions.
Avoid overly literal translations; prioritize natural flow.
